name: web-webpack-sml
description: Reproduces PostHog/posthog-js#4724: webpack + source-map-loader (the CRA setup) emits one warning per unresolvable entry in posthog-js's shipped source maps, because 1.421.1+ strips sourcesContent and the referenced src/*.ts files are not in the published package. `build` shows the warnings against the pinned current release; `build:before` builds the same app against 1.421.0 (the last release with sourcesContent) and is clean.
